profile_text: With a focus on the transportation and storage sector, this German-based firm has experienced rapid growth of 350.0% since its baseline, driven by its expertise in providing tailored business services and consulting solutions to companies operating in Germany and internationally. As a Scaler, it has successfully expanded its operations to meet the increasing demand for specialized services in the logistics and transportation industry. With a team of 18 employees as of 2024, the company continues to build on its strengths in professional consulting and business services.
